goals.title: Fund the government on time
goals.summary: Pass all 12 appropriations bills by the deadline instead of shutdowns and stopgaps, and keep surface transportation funding at FY2026 levels in the FY2027 THUD bill.
goals.psc_ask: Negotiate and pass all 12 appropriations bills on time; restore highway, airport and transit funding (about $19B in proposed cuts) in FY2027 THUD.

goals.title: Keep data center power costs off household bills
goals.summary: Make data centers of 100 MW or more pay the full cost of the generation and grid they need, so utility bills for families and small businesses do not rise to serve them.
goals.psc_ask: The House passed the Ratepayer Protection Act 417-3; the caucus asked Senate leaders to bring it up and pass it. Cloture on the motion to proceed failed 57-43 on 2026-09-30.

bills.what: Directs state regulators to consider standards making large-load customers such as data centers cover the full cost of new generation, transmission and distribution.
bills.label: H.R. 9340
bills.title: Ratepayer Protection Act

latest.text: Motion to proceed to consideration of measure withdrawn in Senate. (CR S5199)

bills.senate_result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected 57-43 (3/5 required) (Cloture on the motion to proceed to H.R. 9340, 2026-09-30).

goals.title: Lower housing and home energy costs
goals.summary: The housing and energy part of the caucus's February 2026 affordability agenda, covering more housing supply, LIHEAP administration, and clearer VA home loan terms for veterans.
goals.psc_ask: Move the affordability agenda bills for housing supply, home energy help and VA loans.

unnumbered.title: Affordable Housing Credit Improvement Act
unnumbered.what: Expands and strengthens the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit.

unnumbered.title: Accelerating Home Building Act
unnumbered.what: Helps local governments speed up permitting and home building.

bills.what: Sets a minimum adequate staffing level for running the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program.
bills.label: H.R. 3876
bills.title: LIHEAP Staffing Support Act

latest.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bills.label: H.R. 3694
bills.title: VALID Act of 2025

latest.text: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

goals.title: Cut costs for caregivers and young families
goals.summary: Tax relief for family caregivers and early childhood educators, and remote WIC enrollment, from the affordability agenda and later endorsements.
goals.psc_ask: Pass the Credit for Caring Act (endorsed 2026-10-22) and the child care and WIC bills in the affordability agenda.

unnumbered.title: Early Childhood Educator Expense Deduction (SEED) Act
unnumbered.what: Gives early childhood educators the same expense deduction K-12 teachers get. (The press release cites H.R. 5334, but that number belongs to a different bill, so it is left unnumbered.)

bills.what: A tax credit of up to $5,000 a year for working family caregivers' costs such as home care, adult day care and respite care.
bills.label: H.R. 2036
bills.title: Credit for Caring Act of 2025

latest.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

bills.what: Lets families complete WIC certification and receive benefits remotely.

bills.title: MODERN WIC Act of 2025

latest.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

goals.title: Stabilize the national debt
goals.summary: Set up bipartisan machinery to stabilize the debt, which passed $40 trillion in August 2026, and test whether the government could absorb a recession or other shock.
goals.psc_ask: Pass a bipartisan fiscal commission, a 10-year balanced-budget panel, and annual fiscal stress tests.

bills.what: Creates a congressionally led bipartisan commission to propose ways to stabilize the debt.
bills.label: H.R. 3289
bills.title: Fiscal Commission Act

latest.text: Referred to the Committee on the Budget, and in addition to the Committee on Rules, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bills.title: Sustainable Budget Act of 2025

latest.text: Referred to the Committee on the Budget, and in addition to the Committee on Rules, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

goals.title: Protect access to care
goals.summary: Faster Medicare Advantage prior authorization, stable Medicare lab payments, a stronger sepsis response, and no waiting periods for metastatic breast cancer patients.
goals.psc_ask: Pass the caucus-endorsed health bills; two have cleared committee votes.

goals.title: Rebuild roads, transit and first-responder facilities
goals.summary: Pass a multi-year surface transportation bill, BUILD America 250, before this Congress ends, and fund facilities for small and rural police and fire departments.
goals.psc_ask: Bring H.R. 8870 to the floor (committee vote 62-2) and pass the BUILD Act.

bills.what: Multi-year surface transportation reauthorization with faster project approvals and more state flexibility.
bills.label: H.R. 8870
bills.title: BUILD America 250 Act

latest.text: Ordered to be Reported (Amended) by the Yeas and Nays: 62 - 2.

goals.title: Make AI safe and protect deepfake victims
goals.summary: Let victims of non-consensual intimate deepfakes sue the people who make or share them, and press for US leadership on AI safety standards. The caucus started an AI working group in September 2026.
goals.psc_ask: House passage of the DEFIANCE Act, which the Senate already passed; the administration should lead on AI safety standards and US-China AI safety coordination.

bills.what: Creates a civil right of action for victims of non-consensual intimate deepfakes.
bills.label: H.R. 3562
bills.title: DEFIANCE Act of 2025

goals.title: Protect the Senate filibuster
goals.summary: A constitutional amendment requiring three-fifths of senators to end debate, so major legislation keeps needing bipartisan support.

bills.what: Proposes a constitutional amendment that debate on legislation in the Senate cannot close without three-fifths of senators.
bills.label: H.J.Res. 4
bills.title: Proposing an amendment to the Constitution of the United States to provide that debate upon legislation pending before the Senate may not be brought to a close without the concurrence of a minimum of three-fifths of the Senators.

latest.text: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.

goals.title: End partisan gerrymandering
goals.summary: Four caucus bills introduced together on 2026-09-15 to limit mid-decade redistricting, set national map-drawing standards, require independent commissions and standardize court challenges.
goals.psc_ask: Move the four Problem Solvers redistricting bills through Judiciary as a package.

bills.what: Limits states to one congressional redistricting after each census.
bills.label: H.R. 10378
bills.title: Problem Solvers TRUST Act
